title: AnalysisBuddy Plugin Manifest
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the AnalysisBuddy plugin manifest file (plugin.json), protocol v1. Mirrors docs/spec/protocol-v1.md section 7. Unknown top-level fields are permitted (additionalProperties: true).

id.description: Globally unique plugin id. Must equal the id returned by initialize.

entry.description: Process launch entry, resolved relative to the plugin.json directory.

command.description: Executable command. Always resolved relative to the plugin.json directory; global PATH must not be relied on (interpreter-style entries excepted).

args.description: Command-line arguments. May be an empty array.

working_dir.description: Process working directory, resolved relative to the plugin.json directory. Defaults to the plugin.json directory.

match.description: File matching rules. Pre-filter at discovery; the authoritative judgement still goes through can_handle.

extensions.description: Claimed file extensions (lowercase, no dot). An empty array means fingerprint-only matching.

header_fingerprints.description: Header fingerprints: case-insensitive substring matches against the head sample; any hit makes the file a candidate.

min_protocol_version.description: Minimum required protocol version. When greater than the host-supported version the plugin is not loaded and the host suggests upgrading.

author.description: Optional author name. If present it must be a non-empty string (MAN-10).

repository.description: Optional source repository URL. If present it must be a valid https URL (MAN-10; TLS enforced, plain http rejected). May also serve as the value of update_url.

tools.description: Optional adapter constraints, each entry in `{tool} {VersionReq}` syntax, e.g. "AnalysisBuddy >= 0.2.0" (MAN-11). The host checks its own identity and version against these.

update_url.description: Optional update source, a https://github.com repository (full URL or bare owner/repo). Validation and consumption are host-side (module manager); the validator does not judge this field.

notes.description: Entry notes, an array of strings (MAN-12).

changelog.description: Optional version history. When non-empty, entries must be strictly descending by semver and the manifest's own version must appear (MAN-13).

presets.description: Optional scene presets (addendum): each preset describes how to identify a set of metrics this scene cares about, from the plugin's own metric ids/names. The core treats scene semantics as open - plugin authors name their own scenes. Entries are exhaustively matched against the plugin's metric list at apply time.

name.description: Bilingual display name; zh and en both required.

entries.description: Top-level entries, effective for every group.

keywords.description: Fuzzy fallback keywords, enabled only when exhaustive matching is entirely empty.

want.description: Optional semantic slot id; for the same want only the first hit takes effect.

names.description: Candidate names: normalized metric_id or raw metric name.
